purpose: Executable business contracts for release-significant frontend workflows. Each contract must define user actions, UI proof, backend proof, security invariants, audit invariants, failure cases, and executable evidence.

expectedBackend: protected API calls require authenticated context
workspace selection binds tenant context
securityInvariants: direct protected route access redirects unauthenticated users
expired tokens cannot access protected API calls
auditInvariants: authentication-sensitive actions carry actor and tenant context where audited

expectedUi: completed output appears in value tree
expectedBackend: one ingestion job is created
graph records are scoped to the actor tenant
duplicate submission follows idempotency contract
securityInvariants: foreign tenants cannot read jobs or graph records
changing tenantSlug does not bypass authorization
auditInvariants: domain ingestion records actor, tenant, action, object, and outcome

expectedUi: signals, drivers, evidence, and stakeholders persist across tabs
expectedBackend: generated intelligence persists for the selected account
citations resolve to accessible evidence
securityInvariants: cross-account and cross-tenant intelligence is not visible
unsupported claims are not promoted as facts
auditInvariants: agent synthesis and accepted recommendations are traceable

expectedBackend: calculation state persists

securityInvariants: unauthorized users cannot mutate account value models

auditInvariants: model edits and narrative generation are traceable

expectedBackend: decision trace links back to source evidence

securityInvariants: cross-tenant audit entries are inaccessible

auditInvariants: AI-generated outputs have provenance and audit context

expectedUi: admin routes are visible only to admin users
expectedBackend: restricted API calls deny insufficient tier or role
tenant-scoped authorization is enforced independently of UI visibility
securityInvariants: UI hiding is not the only authorization control for restricted routes
direct API denial has an exact unauthorized or role-denied failure mode
auditInvariants: sensitive denied actions are auditable where policy requires

expectedBackend: citation IDs resolve to accessible evidence
